meta: Electricity bill shot up and you don't know why? Ask AI to read the bill and find the most power-hungry appliance at home.

muc.title: The bill shot up
muc.text: This month's electricity bill almost doubled and you don't know why. AI helps you read the bill and find the power hog.

muc.title: Units and price tiers
muc.text: Photograph the bill, cover your customer code and address, and ask AI to explain the units used and the tiered pricing.

muc.title: List your appliances
muc.text: List your appliances and how many hours a day you use them, and ask AI to estimate which uses the most.

muc.title: Three easy changes
muc.text: Ask AI for three easy changes, then compare next month's usage. AI's numbers are only estimates.

muc.title: Rank the power hogs
muc.text: Tell a chatbot your five most-used appliances and their daily hours, and ask for a power-use ranking.
